answer: To blunt sybil farms, every agent funds a time-locked vault that only thaws after its work survives a sliding ten-epoch horizon. In each epoch a random pulse of established miners is drawn to replay a hidden probe against that work; matching latency bands, lexical skeletons, or error signatures collapse the implicated identities into one principal. The shared vault is then slashed to the earliest deposit and withdrawals freeze until independent, non-clustered attestations refill the horizon. Spawning aliases therefore burns the original stake instead of multiplying votes.
